title: Urging, Warning, and Forbidding
goal: I can report commands, requests, and warnings using hogy + the subjunctive-imperative mood
I can pair main-clause cataphoric pronouns (arra kér, attól óv, azt követeli) with jussive subordinate clauses
I can use B2 vocabulary of persuasion, admonition, and theatrical direction

sections.title: Unit 4: Performance, Drama & Persuasion
body: Hungarian theatre and political rhetoric have long served as the crucible of national consciousness. From the premiere of József Katona's tragedy Bánk bán to contemporary parliamentary and stage debates, persuasive Hungarian relies on the full expressive range of the subjunctive-imperative mood (-jon/-jen/-jön).

In this unit, you will master indirect commands after verbs of urging and forbidding, negative purpose clauses introduced by the warning conjunction nehogy ('lest / so that ... not'), deliberative questions in moments of moral crisis, and elevated concessive formulas such as legyen bármilyen nehéz is ('be it ever so difficult').

sections.title: Lesson Goals

I can pair main-clause cataphoric pronouns (arra kér, attól óv, azt követeli) with jussive subordinate clauses
I can use B2 vocabulary of persuasion, admonition, and theatrical direction
